values.en: A **plane curve** is a smooth (that is, $C^{\infty}$) map $\gamma\colon (a,b)\to\mathbb{R}^{2}$. If in addition $\gamma'(t)\neq 0$ for every $t\in(a,b)$, then $\gamma$ is called **regular**, and a smooth map with this property is called a **regular smooth plane curve**. The derivative is taken on the open interval, so no one-sided endpoint derivative is required.
values.zh-CN: **平面曲线**是光滑（即 $C^{\infty}$）映射 $\gamma\colon (a,b)\to\mathbb{R}^{2}$。若进一步对每个 $t\in(a,b)$ 都有 $\gamma'(t)\neq 0$，则称 $\gamma$ 为**正则**的；具有该性质的光滑映射称为**正则光滑平面曲线**。导数在开区间上取，因而无需端点单侧导数。
